description: Use this when the user wants to find a flat, house, cottage or plot for sale or rent in Slovakia now. Pass what they are looking for as one short phrase (Slovak works best), e.g. "2-izbový byt Bratislava do 200000 €". Returns up to 20 properties from LivinIsto's offer in LivinIsto's own order, each with a link to the property on www.livinisto.sk, plus what was understood, which words were not applied and what had to be relaxed. For rent the price is per month. When suggestIntent is true (nothing or little found, or part of the phrase was dropped), offer the user intent_publish_intent with the same statement so LivinIsto keeps watching. Results come from listings LivinIsto aggregates from the Slovak market and may be incomplete; no seller or agent contact is returned.

limit.description: At most this many properties (default 10; LivinIsto returns at most 10).

statement.description: What the user is looking for, e.g. "dom Žilina do 250000 €".

name: intent_search_offers
title: Search properties LivinIsto offers today
